layout.body: Switch between the map and the table of the same level. The table is the alternative for the keyboard and screen readers, and it also lets you enter each boundary.

breadcrumbs.title: Map path
breadcrumbs.body: Shows where you are: world, country, region and city. Press a level to go back to it; Esc goes up one level. A level with a single element is skipped and appears without a link.

legend.title: Legend
legend.body: Explains the colors: the darker, the higher the value of the boundary. Those without data are striped, so they are not mistaken for the lowest value.

canvas.title: The map
canvas.body: Click a boundary to enter its lower level. Those without detail do not open. Esc goes up one level.
